testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select options, filter tabs, modal triggers, status dropdowns, lead table rows) MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow React .js file conventions (components in .jsx or .js as existing in repo).
Ensure Sonner toast notifications (from src/components/ui/sonner) are triggered on form submissions and lead updates.
Implement full dark/light theme toggle functionality integrated with tailwind class 'dark'.
Build a robust state-managed lead administration dashboard with sample leads across all 6 pipeline stages.
Ensure mobile responsiveness with hamburger navigation drawer and responsive grids.
